mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_message_delivery_task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND channel=#{channel} AND status=#{status} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id FROM dms_message_delivery_task WHERE channel IN ('SMS','APP_PUSH','MINI_PROGRAM') AND ((status IN ('PENDING','RETRYABLE','ACCEPTED') AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= #{now})) OR (status='SENDING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now}))) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_message_delivery_task SET status='SENDING',lease_owner=#{owner},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND ((status IN ('PENDING','RETRYABLE','ACCEPTED') AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= #{now})) OR (status='SENDING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now})))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_message_delivery_task WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT task.id task_id,task.tenant_id,task.message_id,message.member_id,message.user_id,task.event_type,task.channel, message.title,message.summary,message.content,member.phone FROM dms_message_delivery_task task JOIN dms_member_message message ON message.id=task.message_id AND message.tenant_id=task.tenant_id JOIN dms_shop_member member ON member.id=message.member_id AND member.user_id=message.user_id WHERE task.id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_message_delivery_task SET attempt_count=attempt_count+1,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND status='SENDING'

UPDATE dms_message_delivery_task SET status=#{status},provider_code=#{providerCode},provider_message_id=#{providerMessageId}, actual_cost=actual_cost+COALESCE(#{actualCost},0),error_code=#{errorCode},error_message=#{errorMessage}, lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,next_retry_time=NULL,sent_time=CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('ACCEPTED','DELIVERED') THEN COALESCE(sent_time,#{resolvedTime}) ELSE sent_time END, accepted_time=CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('ACCEPTED','DELIVERED') THEN COALESCE(accepted_time,#{resolvedTime}) ELSE accepted_time END, delivered_time=CASE WHEN #{status}='DELIVERED' THEN COALESCE(delivered_time,#{resolvedTime}) ELSE delivered_time END,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND status='SENDING'

UPDATE dms_message_delivery_task SET status='RETRYABLE',retry_count=#{retryCount},next_retry_time=#{nextRetryTime}, error_code=#{errorCode},error_message=#{errorMessage},lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND status='SENDING'

UPDATE dms_message_delivery_task SET status='SENDING',provider_code=#{providerCode},provider_message_id=#{providerMessageId}, error_code=#{errorCode},error_message=#{errorMessage},lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=#{leaseUntil},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND status='SENDING'

UPDATE dms_message_delivery_task SET status=#{status},provider_code=#{providerCode},provider_message_id=COALESCE(#{providerMessageId},provider_message_id), error_code=#{errorCode},error_message=CASE WHEN #{status}='PERMANENT' THEN '供应商回执确认发送失败' ELSE NULL END, lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,next_retry_time=NULL, sent_time=CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('ACCEPTED','DELIVERED') THEN COALESCE(sent_time,#{resolvedTime}) ELSE sent_time END, accepted_time=CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('ACCEPTED','DELIVERED') THEN COALESCE(accepted_time,#{resolvedTime}) ELSE accepted_time END, delivered_time=CASE WHEN #{status}='DELIVERED' THEN COALESCE(delivered_time,#{resolvedTime}) ELSE delivered_time END,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND status IN ('SENDING','ACCEPTED')
UPDATE dms_message_delivery_task SET next_retry_time=#{nextRetryTime},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ACCEPTED'
